title: Mittag-Leffler inverse system of abelian groups (Stacks 02N0)
statement: Let $(A_i)_{i\ge1}$ be an inverse system of abelian groups [def-weil-inverse-system], with transition homomorphisms $A_{i+1}\to A_i$ and their composites $A_k\to A_i$ for $k\ge i$ (the identity for $k=i$). The system $(A_i)$ satisfies the *Mittag-Leffler condition*, or is *ML*, if for every $i\ge1$ there is an integer $c=c(i)\ge i$ such that $\operatorname{Im}(A_k\to A_i)=\operatorname{Im}(A_c\to A_i)$ (as subgroups of $A_i$) for all $k\ge c$. (For an inverse system of modules over a ring, being ML means that the inverse system of underlying abelian groups is ML.)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line (lines 132--138: `def IsMittagLeffler : Prop := ∀ j : J, ∃ (i : _) (f : i ⟶ j), ∀ ⦃k⦄ (g : k ⟶ j), range (F.map f) ⊆ range (F.map g)`): apply it to $J=\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}$ and the composite of the system $\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ (def-weil-inverse-system, `Functor.ofOpSequence`) with the forgetful functor to `Type`. A morphism $k\to j$ exists iff $k\ge j$, and the images $\operatorname{Im}(A_k\to A_j)$ decrease with $k$ (as $A_{k'}\to A_j$ factors through $A_k$ for $k'\ge k$); so Mathlib's condition with witness $i$ (Im$(A_i\to A_j)\subseteq$ Im$(A_k\to A_j)$ for all $k\ge j$) is the Stacks condition with $c(j)=i$, and conversely. Not used as a type class; the lead may prefer to keep it unsplit with this candidate (delivery-errors B8).
